description: Player 2's do-nothing deck, built to the same two rules as 08-do-nothing-a: nothing resolves unless a spec plays it, and nothing can reduce a hero's health. Spec 08 no longer plays it. Since patch v0.2.0 doubled R2's cap to 60 player-turns (R389), two do-nothing decks fatigue out at player-turn 48 before the cap, so spec 08 plays 08-reserves-b, which is this deck with #100 Ceaseless Void swapped for #75 Infinite Reserves. This deck stays as a quiet bystander for specs 17, 21 and 25. Its card list differs from seat 1's so that no spec asserts a mirror of one shuffle, but the constraints are identical. Every cost is 3 or more, so R82 auto-ends this seat's first two turns, when max mana is 1 and then 2. There is no Cast-on-draw (#21, #27), no Quickdraw (#65, #84, #98) and no hand trigger (#89). There is no X-cost card (#24, #74, #98): an X card is playable for X = 1 with turn one's 1 mana (R348) and would keep the turn open from the start. There is no embiggen card either (#46, #59, #84 pay their base 2 and would be affordable too early). Seat 2 opens on 4 cards (setup step 2), so its library holds 16, which lasts until its 16th turn.
